traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria from story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are satisfied: - File-level @supports annotations in test files are enforced by ensureFileSupportsAnnotation, with clear error messages and safe auto-fix templates (REQ-TEST-FILE-SUPPORTS, REQ-TEST-SUPPORTS-VALID via other rules). - describe() (and equivalent) blocks are required to reference a story pattern by default, enforced via describePattern and missingDescribeStory (REQ-TEST-DESCRIBE-STORY). - it()/test() names must start with a [REQ-XXX] prefix; violations are reported with missingReqPrefix and malformed prefixes are normalized without guessing requirement IDs (REQ-TEST-IT-REQ-PREFIX, REQ-TEST-ERROR-CONTEXT). - The rule follows ESLint best practices (meta, schema, messages, fixable), integrates with the plugin’s index and recommended/strict configs, and limits work to test files using configurable patterns (Quality Standards, Integration). - Multi-framework support is implemented by recognizing describe/it/test/context and member variants like describe.each (REQ-TEST-FRAMEWORK-COMPAT). - Rule behavior and configuration are documented in user-docs/api-reference.md (Documentation criterion). - Dedicated tests in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts cover both passing and failing scenarios for all key requirements, and all project tests pass, confirming a complete and correct implementation.
